content: Iso ya꞉ mamadulo
Aisek yami Iso ya꞉ hi haleye Edom demdepo. Epame ya꞉ mape ya꞉ mamaduloye sikemte pasatana.
Epedeme Isotapo Keinan wola꞉ dapiyamte halomaiyo. A꞉ya hale hiye Ada, Hitai elele halë oplami Elon yotiyo. Epame a꞉ya hale hiye Oholibama, Hibai elele halë oplami Sibeon yami Ana yotiyo.
Epame ya꞉ matle ya꞉ nana, Ismael yoti Basemat haiyo. Basemat eye Nebayot ya꞉layo.
Epapeleye Iso ya꞉llu Adatapo maseyemala hatlo himiyo, ya꞉ hiye Elipas. Epame Iso ya꞉llu hale Basemattapo maseyemala hatlo himiyo, ya꞉ hiye Luwel.
Epame Iso ya꞉llu hale Oholibamatapo akimlala dapahatlope hatitimaiyo, yia꞉ hiye Yus, epo Yalam, epo Kola. Epedeme Isotapo Keinan mo dla halemama akimlala iwoloye hatitimaiyo.

Epapedeme Iso mate epo Yokob mate yia꞉ta madipatata Keinan mo dla ha꞉ha꞉le dulu dla yia꞉ aliya halota sikemte pasatamama mo ha꞉ha꞉lowe kustimalati ya꞉ bapa Isotapo ya꞉ wola꞉ mate epo ya꞉ yimlala mate epame ya꞉ aliya halo mate epo ya꞉ alisisi hapuloma mate ma mo hale Seil mo dla ha꞉ha꞉la taiyo.
Isoye Edom elele halë so yia꞉ mama patopo. Epedeme ya꞉ mamadulo Seil mo dla ha꞉ha꞉lalo so yia꞉ hiye ipo.

Iso ya꞉llu hale Adatapo maseyemala hatlo himiyo, ya꞉ hiye Elipas. Epalati Elipas ya꞉ akimlala hiye Teman, epo Omal, epo Sepo, epo Gatam, epo Kenas. Epame Iso yami Elipasta ma a꞉ya hale Timna hapame maseyemala hatlo himiyo, ya꞉ hiye Amalek. Iso ya꞉llu hale Basemattapo maseyemala hatlo himiyo, ya꞉ hiye Luwel. Epame Luwel ya꞉ akimlala hiye Nahat, epo Yela, epo Sama, epo Misa.
Epame ma Iso ya꞉llu hale Sibeon yami Ana yoti Oholibamata akimlala dapahatlope hatitimaiyo, yia꞉ hiye Yus, epo Yalam, epame Kola.

Epapele dulu dla Iso ya꞉llu Adata himili maseyemala Elipas tle elele meyelope meyelope dle iwolota ha꞉ha꞉iyo, Teman so, epo Omal so, epo Sepo so, epo Kenas so, epo Kola so, epo Gatam so, epo Amalek so. Epedeme elele meyelope meyelope dle iwoloye Edom mo dla ha꞉ha꞉iyo.

Epame ma Iso ya꞉llu hale Basematta himili maseyemala Luwel tle elele meyelope meyelope dle iwolota ha꞉ha꞉iyo, Nahat so, epo Yela so, epo Sama so, epo Misa so. Epapedeme elele meyelope meyelope dle iwolo mape Edom mo hatlo medla me-ha꞉ha꞉iyo.
Epame ma Iso ya꞉llu hale Ana yoti Oholibama tle elele meyelope meyelope dle iwolota ha꞉ha꞉iyo. Yus so, epo Yalam so, epo Kola so.
Epedeme elele meyelope meyelope dle hapuloma hema hutiyemtuluye, hatlo Iso tle kotiyamale elelepo. Iso ya꞉ hi haleye Edom.
Seil ya꞉ elele halë so

Iso ala Edom mo dla pohallalo hallati Holi elele halë oplami hale Seil tatle mo edla halaiyo. Epedeme elele meyelope meyelope dleta oplami Seil etle kotiyamaleye iwolopo. Lotan so, epo Sobal so, epo Sibeon so, epo Ana so, epo Dison so, epo Esel so, epo Disan so. Epapedeme elele meyelope meyelope dle iwolo mape Edom mo hatlo medla me-ha꞉ha꞉iyo.
Epapeleye Lotan ya꞉ akimlalaye Holi mate epo Homan matepo. Epalati Lotan ya꞉ nanaye Timnapo.
Epalati Sobal ya꞉ akimlala hiye Alban, epo Manahat, epo Ebal, epo Sepo, epo Onam.
Epame ma Sibeon ya꞉ akimlala hiye Aiya mate epo Ana matepo. Epapeleye Ana itapo ya꞉ a donki aliya halo omhalemama dalupa pa꞉le mo dla yú matale natiyo.
Epapele dulu dla Ana ya꞉ yimlala hiye Dison mate epo Oholibama matepo.
Epalati Dison ya꞉ akimlala hiye Hemdan, epo Esban, epo Itlan, epo Kelan.
Epalati ma Esel ya꞉ akimlala hiye Bilhan, epo Saban, epo Akan.
Epalati ma Disan ya꞉ akimlala hiye Us mate epo Alan matepo.

Epapedeme Holi elele halomale soye iwolopo, Lotan so, epo Sobal so, epo Sibeon so, epo Ana so, epo Dison so, epo Esel so, epo Disan so. Epapedeme elele meyelope meyelope dle iwoloye Seil mo dla ha꞉ha꞉iyo.
Edom mo dokopala so
Epapele dulu dla Isalael mo omhallalo dokopala ala pohallalo hallati dokopala so opi iwolo tatle Edom moye dokopala depo ha꞉ha꞉iyo.
Dokopala oplami haleye Beol yami Bela. Ya꞉ye Dinaba mo dla hallalo oplamipo.
Epame Belata mo-polati Yela yami Yobabta halaiyo. Ya꞉ye Bosla mo dla hallalo oplamipo.
Epame Yobabta mo-polati matle Husamta halaiyo. Ya꞉ye Teman mo dla hallalo oplamipo.
Epame Husamta mo-polati ma Bedad yami Hadadta halaiyo. Ya꞉ye Abit mo dla hallalo oplamipo. Ya꞉ta halemama Moab mo dla tame Midiya so mate opahale demama ya꞉ opatapo tla꞉mtaiyo.
Epame Hadadta mo-polati ma Samlata halaiyo. Ya꞉ye Masleka mo dla hallalo oplamipo.
Epame ma Samlata mo-polati ma Saulta halaiyo. Ya꞉ye Yupalates aloma pili dla Lehobot mo dla hallalo oplamipo.
Epo Saulta mo-polati ma Akbol yami Bal Hananta halaiyo.
Epame Bal Hananta mo-polati ma Hadadta halaiyo. Ya꞉ye Pau mo pato dla hallalo oplamipo. Epedeme Hadad ya꞉lluye Matled yoti Mehetabelpo, ya꞉ye Mesahab ya꞉ awapo.

Epapedeme Iso elele halomale soye iwolopo. Timna so, epo Alba so, epo Yetet so, epo Oholibama so, epo Ela so, epo Pinon so, epo Kenas so, epo Teman so, epo Mibsal so, epo Magdiel so, epo Ilam so. Epedeme elele meyelope meyelope dle iwolotapo Edom mo pato dulu dla miyelo mepo mo kestepo ha꞉ha꞉ demtaiyo.
